text:
```yaml
name: Stale issue and PR automation

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 1 * * *'  # 1:30 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Mark stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          daysUntilStale: 90
          daysUntilClose: 60
          staleLabel: stale
          staleMessage: |
            👋 Hi there! This issue/PR has been inactive for a while and has been marked as **stale**. If you still need help or want to keep it active, please add a comment or a label. Otherwise, it will be closed in 60 days.
          closeMessage: |
            🚫 This issue/PR has been closed because it remained stale for 60 days. If you still need assistance, feel free to reopen or create a new issue/PR.
          exemptLabels: lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned
          exemptAssignees: true
          exemptMilestones: true
          removeStaleLabel: true
          operations: issues,pull-requests
```
